name: quic-mlkem-benchmark
description: Release Overview Initial release of the empirical testbed, telemetry datasets, and replication artifacts for evaluating NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM) key encapsulation in QUIC (RFC 9000 / RFC 9001). Key Contents Network Namespace Automation: Bare-metal isolation scripts (netns_setup.sh, netns_cleanup.sh, apply_netem.sh) for reproducible network impairment injection. Emulation Engine & Orchestration: aioquic-based wire-format cryptographic emulation (quic_engine.py, orchestrator.py) supporting X25519, ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, and hybrid X25519-ML-KEM-768. Empirical Telemetry: Aggregated 2,400-run benchmark matrix (benchmark_results.csv) across varying RTTs (20ms, 80ms, 160ms) and loss rates (0%, 1%, 3%, 5%). Sample Traces: Curated PCAP and TLS key files (sample_pcaps/) validating datagram fragmentation and anti-amplification credit behavior. Analysis Routines: Plot generation and metric extraction pipeline (analyze_proofs.py, generate_summary.py). Archival & Citation This release serves as the persistent artifact package for Zenodo DOI minting and reproducibility verification.
